name: learning-coach
author: alan0x
description: Generate validated OLL whiteboard lessons for learning sessions

tools.name: oll_generate_lesson
tools.description: After resolving the learner request to exactly one authoritative source, generate, validate, save, and deliver the OLL lesson. Use self_contained for a complete standalone request, current_image for a request grounded in the current frame, and explicit_board_follow_up only when the learner explicitly continues prior board work. Never use board history to fill an incomplete request.

learner_request.description: The learner's complete substantive request for this turn.

request_source.description: The single authoritative source resolved for this request. self_contained uses only learner_request; current_image requires source_observation; explicit_board_follow_up requires an explicit learner reference to prior board work and board_summary. If no source can be resolved safely, do not call the tool—ask the learner to clarify.

tutor_context.description: Concise teaching-persona or strategy context known for this turn.

learner_context.description: Tentative learner background relevant to the requested explanation.

session_context.description: Controlled OLL resource context, including only assets and regions supplied by the host.

board_summary.description: Summary of the existing board. It is exposed to lesson generation only for explicit_board_follow_up and must never fill missing content in another request source.

last_applied_action.description: Last committed board action supplied by the host.

base_revision.description: Existing board revision when supplied by the host.

source_observation.description: Authoritative problem transcribed from the current image after visual grounding. Omit when the request is not image-dependent.

recognized_problem.description: Exact readable problem statement, givens, and learner target from the current image.

tools.name: oll_enhance_selection
tools.description: Create a separate explanation, annotation, or safe 2D function plot beside an immutable student-ink selection. Use only when [[LEARNING_SELECTION]] requires this exact tool. Copy the source identity fields exactly, describe only the selected image, and never rewrite or replace the source ink.

recognized_content.description: Only what is visible in the selected image; do not use the rest of the board. State uncertainty in recognition_confidence.
